explanation: Mostly a clock that falls steadily over the episode at every step: about 10 for trials 0-35, 9 around trials 40-50, 8 around trials 55-75, 6 around trial 80, 3-4 around trial 90 and 0-2 by trials 93-99, running about 1-2 lower when the agent has been choosing a2 late in the episode. Late in the episode, D1 after a reward dips 1-2 below the GO/D2 values around it, while D1 after no reward is 1-3 higher and is then followed by a lower GO.
